Legos @ the Library

Monday, November 16, 2026

Try our Lego challenge or free build your own creation to be displayed in the library!

Join us in the Community Room for some family Lego fun! We will have a challenge available, or kids and adults can make their own creations that will be displayed in the library! No registration needed.


Email iplprograms@independenceia.gov or call 319-334-2470 for more information.
